# ESP32-S31 investigation contract overlay

Public ABI and lifecycle fixture data tied to this vendor investigation:
external callback tables, the registered mutable pointer-cell state, linked
archive symbol bindings and private diagnostic boundaries. It extends the
reusable rev0 cold-ROM contract crate and exports the explicit combined
contract superset used by the project provider.

This crate does not load or authenticate artifacts, but its archive source
names and versioned interface model IDs are not thereby chip-wide facts. The
reviewed project and its authenticated inputs own their applicability.
